name: Dragon Metrics
description_en:
Dragon Metrics combines configured search-rank tracking, technical crawling, competitive research and client reporting. Its documented engine coverage includes Asian and European regional search services as well as Google and Bing. A campaign defines a monitored site and search panels; on-demand research uses a separate database and allowance.

Evaluation is most useful when it follows one site from panel selection through crawl scope, ranking interpretation and a scheduled client report. The important constraints are the unit charged for each search combination, irreversible keyword-tracking mode selection, editable report snapshots and account-wide API credentials. Official pages disagree on engine totals and describe API usage more broadly than the detailed limits allow. This is a documentation-based draft, with no created campaign, crawl, integration or paid account test.
description_zh:
Dragon Metrics 将配置式搜索排名跟踪、技术抓取、竞品研究及客户报告结合。文档引擎覆盖包括亚洲及欧洲区域搜索服务，以及 Google、Bing。Campaign 定义被监控网站及搜索面板，按需研究另用数据库和额度。

评估适合沿一个网站从面板选择、抓取范围、排名解读走到定期客户报告。关键约束包括每种搜索组合的计量、不可逆的关键词跟踪模式选择、可编辑报告快照及账户全域 API 凭据。官方页对引擎总数存在差异，API 宣传也比详细限额更宽泛。本条为文档草稿，未创建 Campaign、抓取、连接集成或实测付费账户。

core_features.explanation_en: Allocate a credit to each keyword, engine, country, language, device and location combination.
core_features.explanation_zh: 每种关键词、引擎、国家、语言、设备及位置组合分配积分。

core_features.explanation_en: Set spider or URL-list mode and inspect separate JavaScript and image costs.
core_features.explanation_zh: 设蜘蛛或 URL 列表模式，并审独立 JavaScript、图片成本。

core_features.explanation_en: Recurring templates generate separately editable dated reports.
core_features.explanation_zh: 定期模板生成可单独编辑的定日期报告。

core_features.explanation_en: Viewed and exported rows consume a separate monthly research allowance.
core_features.explanation_zh: 浏览及导出行消耗独立月度研究额度。

en: Set a regional SEO campaign with explicitly budgeted search panels.
Investigate crawl coverage before prioritizing technical fixes.
Produce scheduled client reports with deliberate link access and commentary.
zh: 按明确预算的搜索面板设置区域 SEO Campaign。
排技术修复优先级前调查抓取覆盖。
明确链接访问及评语后制作定期客户报告。
use_cases.basis: Editorial workflow examples; not observed customer outcomes.

specific_roles.zh: 区域 SEO 分析人员

steps.en: Specify engine, country, language, device and local panels, then count combinations.
steps.zh: 定引擎、国家、语言、设备及本地面板，再算组合。

steps.en: Choose keyword-level tracking mode before importing any keywords.
steps.zh: 导任何词前选逐词跟踪模式。

steps.en: Check crawl scope, rendering and budget with a representative sample.
steps.zh: 用代表样本核抓取范围、渲染及预算。

steps.en: Compare matching rank sources and dates before interpreting a change.
steps.zh: 解读变化前比较匹配排名来源及日期。

steps.en: Review generated Snapshot dates, recipient access and effective permissions.
steps.zh: 审生成快照日期、接收访问及生效权限。

items.en: Keyword-level engine tracking cannot be reversed once enabled.
items.zh: 逐词引擎跟踪启用后不可恢复原模式。

items.en: Snapshots remain editable; deleting a Template also deletes its snapshots.
items.zh: Snapshot 可编辑，删模板也删其快照。

items.en: API credentials cover the whole account and support writes.
items.zh: API 凭据覆盖全账户并支持写。

items.en: Research, keyword, crawl and API allowances are different meters.
items.zh: 研究、关键词、抓取及 API 额度是不同计量。

supported_languages.scope_en: Documented interface languages; search-engine language coverage is a separate configuration.
supported_languages.scope_zh: 文档列界面语言，搜索引擎语言覆盖是独立配置。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: USD monthly cards with weekly tracking: Starter $99, Basic $249, Standard $499, Pro $749, Enterprise $999; displayed annual monthly equivalents $82/$207/$415/$624/$832, not annual invoices. Starter includes 1,000 keyword credits and 200,000 crawl credits. Daily tracking costs extra. Thirty-day trial: no card, 200 keyword credits and daily tracking; not a sustained free plan. Basic+ includes API; Starter lacks white-label/Looker/API. Exact tax, checkout, daily configurations and large-account quote unverified; no normalized price.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: USD 月付卡默认周跟踪：Starter $99、Basic $249、Standard $499、Pro $749、Enterprise $999；年付显示月等值 $82／$207／$415／$624／$832，不是年账单。Starter 含千关键词及二十万抓取积分，日跟踪另付。三十天免卡试用含二百关键词及日跟踪，不是持续免费。Basic 起含 API，Starter 不含白标／Looker／API。准确税、结账、日更配置及大账户询价未核，不设标准化价。

official_check.scope: Official public documentation only; no purchase, account operation, sending test, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.
All publication and alternative-relationship states remain unapproved.

sections.title_en: Choose the exact search panel before counting keywords
sections.title_zh: 先选准确搜索面板再算关键词
sections.en: The help list names Google, Bing, Yahoo, Baidu, 360/Haosou, Sogou, Naver, Daum and Seznam, with country/language and device options varying by engine. Homepage, pricing and tour engine totals differ, so a single universal count is not established. One keyword tracked on multiple engine, country, language, device or location combinations occupies multiple keyword credits. Editorial setup: write down the actual panels needed for one audience before importing a keyword list. A Google mobile result in one city and a Baidu desktop result are separate observations, not interchangeable measurements of a global position.
sections.zh: 帮助列 Google、Bing、Yahoo、Baidu、360／Haosou、Sogou、Naver、Daum 及 Seznam，各引擎国家／语言及设备选项不同。首页、价格及导览总数不同，未确定统一数量。一个词在不同引擎、国家、语言、设备或位置跟踪，占多份关键词积分。编辑设置：导词表前列出一个受众所需真实面板。某城市 Google 移动结果与 Baidu 桌面结果是独立观察，不是可互换的全球位置。

sections.title_en: Keyword-level engine assignment is a creation-time decision
sections.title_zh: 逐词引擎分配是创建时决策
sections.en: By default every keyword in a campaign shares its search-engine configuration. Keyword-level search-engine tracking permits different assignments, but the guide requires enabling it before any keywords are added and says it cannot be reversed. Groups can then be imported with their own panels or edited individually/in bulk. Editorial first campaign: decide whether regional or device segments need different panels before loading the production list. A later change to reporting tags is not documented as converting this tracking mode. If the intended setup was missed, establish a supported migration path rather than assuming a settings toggle can undo it.
sections.zh: 默认 Campaign 全部词共用搜索引擎配置。逐词搜索引擎跟踪允许不同分配，但指南要求加任何词之前启用，且不可恢复原模式。之后可按组导不同面板，或逐词／批量编辑。编辑首个 Campaign：载入正式词表前决定区域或设备分组是否需不同面板。后改报告标签不等于转换此跟踪模式；漏选时需确定受支持迁移方法，不能假定设置开关可撤回。

sections.title_en: A research row and a tracked rank have different histories
sections.title_zh: 研究行与跟踪排名具有不同历史
sections.en: Rank Tracking observes configured terms daily or weekly according to the account; first results are described as taking about an hour. Ranking Research is an instant lookup of an existing Google/Baidu country-level desktop database, updated monthly. GSC integration supplies an owned property’s daily average position with up to sixteen months of history, while tracked history begins with collection. Editorial discrepancy check: match date, engine, location, language and device before comparing a saved SERP with a personal search or GSC average. An absent research row does not establish absence from live results, and a personal browser result does not independently disprove a different configured panel.
sections.zh: Rank Tracking 按账户每天或每周观察配置词，首次结果文档称约一小时。Ranking Research 即时查询已有 Google／Baidu 国家级桌面数据库，按月更新。GSC 集成为自有属性提供每日平均位置及最多十六月历史，跟踪历史从采集开始。编辑差异检查：比较保存 SERP、个人搜索或 GSC 平均前匹配日期、引擎、位置、语言及设备。研究缺行不证明实时结果没有排名，个人浏览结果也不能独立否定不同配置面板。

sections.title_en: JavaScript rendering changes crawl cost and coverage
sections.title_zh: JavaScript 渲染改变抓取成本及覆盖
sections.en: The crawl guide defaults to automatic runs every fifteen days and JavaScript rendering off. Spider mode follows links; List mode crawls only supplied URLs. Images cost a quarter credit and JavaScript-rendered URLs five credits. Alternate seeds start at depth zero; crawl scope can override the campaign scope without changing ranking/backlink scope and applies on the next run. Editorial sample: verify a representative rendered page, crawl boundary and remaining allowance before a large run. An empty issue list on a narrow, non-rendered or exhausted crawl is not evidence that every production page was inspected. Disabling automatic crawls preserves existing results but stops new automatic runs.
sections.zh: 抓取指南默认每十五天自动运行，JavaScript 渲染关闭。Spider 沿链接，List 只抓提供 URL。图片每份四分之一积分，JavaScript 渲染 URL 五积分；补充种子从深度零开始。抓取范围可独立覆盖 Campaign 范围，不改排名／外链范围，下次运行生效。编辑样本：大批运行前核代表渲染页、边界及余量。范围窄、未渲染或耗尽抓取的问题表为空，不证明检查过全部生产页。关自动抓取保留旧结果并停止新自动运行。

sections.title_en: Missing URLs require a coverage diagnosis
sections.title_zh: 缺 URL 需要诊断覆盖
sections.en: Common Crawling Issues lists missing internal links, excluded scope, exhausted allowance, redirects, cookies/authentication, server failures and blocked crawler access. It also documents downloading only the first 500 KB of HTML and following at most 500 links per page; these published caps were not measured in an account. Editorial recovery: compare the affected URL with the seed, link graph, response and crawl settings before treating a missing page as technically healthy. A page visible in an authenticated human session may not be accessible to the crawler. Preserve the failure and obtain appropriate owner-side configuration instead of treating repeated crawls as a universal repair.
sections.zh: Common Crawling Issues 列无内链、范围排除、额度耗尽、重定向、Cookie／认证、服务器失败及爬虫被阻。还记载只下载 HTML 前 500 KB、每页最多沿 500 链，这些公开上限未实测。编辑恢复：将目标 URL 与种子、链接图、响应及配置比较，再判断技术健康。人工认证会话可见页面，爬虫未必可访问。保留错误并由所有者做适当配置，反复抓取不是通用修复。

sections.title_en: Template schedules generate editable dated Snapshots
sections.title_zh: 模板定期生成可编辑的定日期 Snapshot
sections.en: A Template has relative dates and scheduling settings but cannot itself be distributed as a report URL or PDF. Each generated Snapshot has absolute dates, its own URL and independently editable content. Template changes affect future Snapshots, not previous ones; editing a child does not update siblings. Sharing Template editing also grants access to all its Snapshots. Publishing can send HTML/PDF links to recipients without platform accounts, with optional HTML password protection. Editorial delivery: inspect the generated period, actual recipient access and final commentary before distribution. A Snapshot is a dated report instance, not an immutable audit record or an approval checkpoint.
sections.zh: Template 有相对日期及定时配置，本身不能作为报告 URL 或 PDF 分发。生成 Snapshot 有绝对日期、独立 URL 及可单独编辑正文。模板改动影响未来快照，不改旧项，改子项不更新兄弟项；共享模板编辑权也授其全部快照。发布可向无平台账户接收者发 HTML／PDF 链接，HTML 可选密码。编辑交付：分发前审生成周期、实际访问及最终评语。Snapshot 是定日期报告实例，不是不可变审计记录或审批关卡。

sections.title_en: Archive and delete have different consequences
sections.title_zh: 归档与删除有不同后果
sections.en: Archiving a scheduled report stops future Snapshots while preserving previous reports; unarchiving resumes the schedule. Deleting a Template deletes its associated Snapshots and is documented as irreversible. The stop-schedule article disagrees internally about whether archived reports remain editable, so that behavior is left unresolved. Editorial handover: use a deliberate schedule stop when the requirement is to end recurring delivery, then separately review retained links and data. Do not delete the parent merely to suppress the next email. The documented archive operation is not evidence that previously distributed links were revoked or that recipients lost downloaded PDFs.
sections.zh: 归档定期报告停止未来 Snapshot 并保留旧报告，取消归档恢复定时。删 Template 会删关联快照，文档称不可恢复。停止定时文章对归档报告是否可编辑自相矛盾，此行为未确定。编辑交接：需结束定期交付时明确停定时，再独立审保留链接及数据。不能只为阻下一封邮件就删父项。归档说明不证明撤回旧分享链接，也不证明接收者失去已下载 PDF。

sections.title_en: ROI forecasting is a scenario model
sections.en: The forecast tool does not require Google Analytics. It uses keyword ranking and search volume with an assumed click-through curve, conversion rate and conversion value to model traffic, conversions and value. Engine, tag and reference-date selections change the modeled panel. Editorial scenario: show the assumptions beside the output and compare conservative and optimistic inputs before presenting an investment case. Forecast value is not observed revenue, a causal estimate of one SEO change or a promised return. The help article contains an inconsistent arithmetic example, which is not reproduced here; account calculations and resulting formulas have not been independently tested.
sections.zh: 预测工具不要求 Google Analytics，以关键词排名、搜索量及假设点击曲线、转化率、转化价值模拟流量、转化及价值。引擎、标签及参考日期会改变模型面板。编辑情景：将假设与输出并列，呈投资理由前比较保守及乐观输入。预测价值不是观察收入、某项 SEO 改动的因果估计或回报承诺。帮助含不一致算术示例，此处不复用，未独立测试账户计算及公式结果。

sections.title_en: Research allowance is separate from monitored keywords
sections.title_zh: 研究额度独立于监控词
sections.en: Research credits reset on the first calendar day of each month without rollover. Ranked-keyword results cost one credit per row; related-keyword queries cost 150 for up to 1,000 results. Bulk Google volume lookup has a 150-credit minimum, while Baidu/Naver use two credits per row with a 300-credit minimum; backlink rows cost five. Viewing and exporting both consume credits, and multiple tables are added together. Editorial research batch: estimate rows, query minimums and export needs before opening broad domains. A tracked-keyword allocation is not an interchangeable research balance, and repeating an export is not documented as free because the data was already viewed.
sections.zh: 研究积分每自然月一日重置，不结转。排名词结果每行一积分，相关词查询 150 积分、最多千结果；Google 批量搜索量最低 150，Baidu／Naver 每行二、最低 300，外链行五。浏览与导出都消耗，多表相加。编辑研究批次：开广域查询前估行数、最低查询费及导出需求。跟踪词额度不能与研究余额互换，也不能认为已看过数据再导出免费。

sections.title_en: Role, campaign access and billing permission are independent
sections.title_zh: 角色、Campaign 访问及账单权限独立
sections.en: The August 2026 role guide separates allowed actions, campaign scope and billing access. Read-only users may create their own reports and alerts; Read-only + Research can spend research credits. Standard can edit keywords/competitors, Campaign Manager can manage campaigns but not users, and Manager has restricted user administration. All campaigns includes future campaigns. Billing access separately permits subscription changes and cancellation. Some table cells conflict with the prose’s campaign restrictions. Editorial client access: verify effective campaign scope and billing separately rather than relying on a role name or the table’s green cells. There is one account owner; ownership transfer demotes the prior owner to Manager.
sections.zh: 2026 年八月角色指南分允许动作、Campaign 范围及账单访问。Read-only 可建自己报告及提醒，Read-only + Research 可花研究积分；Standard 可改词／竞品，Campaign Manager 管 Campaign 不管用户，Manager 有限管用户。All campaigns 含未来项，账单访问另允许改订阅及取消。部分表格单元与正文范围限制冲突。编辑客户访问：核真实 Campaign 及账单范围，不能只看角色名或绿色格。账户只有一名 Owner，转所有权使旧 Owner 降为 Manager。

sections.title_en: API credentials grant account-wide read and write access
sections.title_zh: API 凭据授账户全域读写
sections.en: The getting-started guide includes API access from Basic upward, excluding Starter. Credentials differ from interactive login and grant full account read/write access; eligible non-owners need All Campaigns and API Key Access. Detailed docs impose separate monthly credits and fifty requests per minute despite unlimited marketing. Looker Studio connectors spend the same API pool. The usage endpoint is free; other costs vary by endpoint/rows. Both rate and credit exhaustion can produce HTTP 429, while old guides and the error table disagree on internal numeric codes. Editorial integration: cache responses, inspect the returned error, and distinguish short throttling from exhausted monthly allowance before planning recovery.
sections.zh: 入门指南 Basic 起含 API，Starter 不含。凭据不同交互登录，授账户全域读写，合资格非 Owner 需 All Campaigns 及 API Key Access。详细文档设独立月积分及每分钟五十请求，与无限宣传不同。Looker Studio 消耗同一 API 池，usage 端点免费，其他按端点／行计费。速率及积分耗尽都可返回 HTTP 429，旧指南与错误表内部数字代码不同。编辑集成：缓存响应、审真实错误，恢复前区分短时节流及月额度耗尽。

sections.title_en: Downgrade and cancellation require explicit billing authority
sections.title_zh: 降级及取消需明确账单权限
sections.en: The downgrade guide requires the owner or billing-authorized user to contact support; the change takes effect after the current term, without a mid-term refund. Cancellation is available in Usage & Billing, displays the actual access-end date and includes an export reminder before final confirmation. A trial without a payment method expires without a cancellation action. Editorial exit: export required ranking/report data while access remains active and record the account’s displayed end date. Public documentation does not establish a universal post-cancellation retention or recovery window, and no cancellation or refund was exercised during this research.
sections.zh: 降级指南要求 Owner 或账单授权用户联系支持，当前周期后生效，期中无退款。取消在 Usage & Billing，显示真实访问截止日并在最终确认前提醒导出。无付款方式试用自然到期，无需取消动作。编辑退出：有访问时导所需排名／报告数据，记录账户显示截止日。公开文档未确定统一取消后保留或恢复窗口，本研究未取消或办理退款。
